content.comment_body: Hello, regarding this topic: Is there a microSD card available from [company_name], or do we need to buy it from another supplier? If [company_name] offers one, could you provide the relevant part number?
Welcome to the forum. You can use any microSD card, as long as it is formatted with FAT32 and has a maximum size of 32 GB. For cards larger than 32 GB, you'll need to set up a 32 GB FAT32 partition.

analysis.insight_summary: User is looking for guidance on sourcing and compatibility of microSD cards for a [company_name] device. Responses clarify that any standard microSD card can be used, with formatting and size restrictions, and indicate that [company_name] does not supply a dedicated card or official part number for this purpose.
analysis.user_expectations: User hoped to learn whether [company_name] supplies official microSD cards and expected advice on compatible card specifications, including whether an official part number is available.
